title: Compact SKU redesign — go-to-market synchronization and launch runbook
creator: Ava Martin
description: Objective: consolidate existing SKU surface into a compact three-tier model (Developer, Business, Enterprise) with harmonized request/embedding limits and clearer entitlement boundaries. Scope: SKU design, billing mapping, entitlement migration scripts, customer communications, release notes, internal enablement, and coordinated cutover across Billing, Console, Customer Success, Sales, and Engineering. Success criteria: (1) <=1% billing deltas outside expected ranges during first billing cycle post-migration, (2) zero-production incidents caused by entitlement mismatch, (3) Sales and CS enablement materials published and acknowledged by teams before cutover, (4) release notes and billing FAQs published at least 48 hours before public launch.
acceptance_criteria: Billing mapping tested end-to-end with synthetic accounts and top-50 customers matched
Migration scripts run in sandbox and dry-run shows no dropped entitlements
Console SKU picker and limits updated in staging and validated with QA
Customer-facing release notes drafted and legal-approved
Sales deck and one-pager published in Drive and reviewed by GTM leadership
Support runbook and error messages updated and available in Zendesk
rollout_plan: Week -2: Finalize SKU definitions, limits, and pricing anchors; freeze changes to related billing models
Week -1: Run migration dry-runs on staging and synthetic accounts; publish internal release notes and enablement
Day -3: Open read-only window for entitlement edits in Console for migration safety
Day -2: Publish public release notes and billing FAQ; email customers flagged as high-impact
Day 0: Run migration job in production during maintenance window; monitor token billing metrics and entitlement logs
Day +1 to +7: Post-migration reconciliation, cold-path rollback strategy available if billing delta > 1.5% for top-100 accounts
Week +4: Billing analytics review and customer follow-ups; finalize FAQ updates
release_notes_summary: We are simplifying product packaging into three primary SKUs to make pricing clearer and reduce cognitive load when selecting plans. Existing customers will be mapped to equivalent tiers automatically. Some account-level limits will change; see the billing FAQ for details and migration timelines.
comms_plan: Internal: Announcement in #product and #gtm Slack channels with links to playbook and enablement assets
Sales/AE: Live walkthrough session + Q&A scheduled two times ahead of go-live; one-pager with migration impact matrix
Customer Success: Prepare outreach list for accounts with >$5k MRR or custom entitlements
Public: Release notes on docs and banner on Console; targeted email to customers with limit changes
Support: Updated Zendesk macros and CS playbook with escalation paths
sales_enablement_tasks: Create SKU mapping cheat-sheet comparing old SKUs to new tiers
Record a 15-min walkthrough video and publish to Drive
Prepare objection-handling FAQ for pricing differences and credits
Update product collateral and pricing page snapshots for demos
Schedule two live sessions for Enterprise AEs and account teams

risks: Entitlement mismatch causing customers to lose access to features
Billing reconciliation errors leading to incorrect invoices
Confusion in sales conversations increases deal cycle time
Late QA discovery of Console edge-case showing wrong limits
mitigations: Dry-run migration on mirror of top-200 accounts and reconcile differences
Keep dual-lookup logic for 72 hours to serve old entitlements if mismatch detected
Provide sales with migration impact tags on key accounts before outreach
Hold a staging smoke-test window with QA, Eng, and CS validating top flows
